newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market brisk at $69 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market brisk at $69 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher, USDA said.
Inquiry and demand was strong. Sales confirmed on 20,400 slaughter steers and 12,900 slaughter heifers Wednesday.
For the week to date 79,700 head confirmed including 14,600 head or about 18 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1300 lbs mostly 1150-1225 lbs 69.00; pen Select with end Choice 1150 lbs 68.00. Dressed basis - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 112.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 990-1200 lbs mostly 1025-1100 lbs 69.00, one pen 68.50; pen Select with end Choice 1075 lbs 68.00.
Wk to date - 79,700 last week - 40,900 last year - 12,700
